title: Phase 2：反例搜尋器第四批（Sun、Cloitre）：推翻 A073631 的猜想（3842760169²）

A073631.proof: 3842760169 is a base-3/2 Wieferich prime (A376896), so k = 3842760169^2 is a nonsquarefree term not divisible by 23^2, and a square term other than 1, 529. Lean a073631_counterexample. Least counterexample: square factors of terms are base-3/2 Wieferich primes (paper lemma) and none lie in (23, 3842760169) (search to 2^32).

novelty.note: Immediate from A376896 (2024) plus a one-line order argument; nothing new claimed. The value is linking the two entries and correcting the open conjecture. Web, MathSciNet, zbMATH not searched.
